purpose: Separate predictor-version development comparison after nominal predictor audit
inputs: same estimated state/actuator/scheduled speed/local curvature as frozen evaluator; no true episode mu or stiffness
cost: nonlinear local parabolic-road bank rollout, 50ms candidate hold then nominal LQR, 200ms total; frozen tracking/effort cost weights
acceptance: at least 1% predicted improvement in EVERY bank member and >=1e-7 absolute improvement; choose best worst relative margin among unchanged ramp-limited 0.1/0.25/0.5 choices; unchanged persistence/age/envelope rules
evaluation: same72 development cells per legacy and A100k policy, same noise base6100000; compare stored paired frozen-gate/LQR reference rows; 144 new episodes
promotion: No survival loss, no regional mean >1% worse than frozen gate, nominal <=2% worse, stress mean improves in both seeds, exact100ms LQR fallback. No automatic deployment or further training.
limits: Fixed uncertainty bank is not a state estimator or guarantee; unmodeled geometry, estimation and dynamics remain. Single new design; no post-result tuning or reserved evaluation.
